parameters.name: DBNodeIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the nodes. To specify multiple node IDs, separate the IDs with a comma (,).

parameters.name: FromTimeService
parameters.description: Specifies whether to apply the parameter modifications and restart the node. Valid values: \`false\` (default): Schedules the task. \`true\`: Executes the task immediately.

parameters.name: ParameterGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the parameter template.

parameters.name: Parameters
parameters.description: A JSON string that contains the parameters and their values.

parameters.name: PlannedEndTime
parameters.description: The latest time to start the scheduled task. The time must be in the \`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ\` format and in UTC.

parameters.name: PlannedStartTime
parameters.description: The earliest time to start the scheduled task. The time must be in the \`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ\` format and in UTC.
